cited_evidence: Top-level corpus first record has record_id n06-r01 and source_id s01.
Job 1 needs output preserves record_id n06-r01 for the same need.
Job 1 evidence_sources output for rank 1 has record_id s01 and source_id s01, showing record_id was changed to the source identity.
The semantic declaration assigns evidence_sources construction to job_1 function assemble_provenance.
Job 2 priorities output has upstream_rank 0 for all eight records despite evidence_sources input containing rank values 1 through 8.
initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance identity fault in the upstream evidence_sources handoff. The needs handoff preserves demand record_ids such as n06-r01, but evidence_sources replaces record_id with source IDs such as s01. Downstream priority ranking then cannot carry the upstream provenance ranks onto the coverage records, producing upstream_rank: 0 for every priority even though evidence_sources contains ranks 1 through 8.
